ai_language_tip: 用清楚英語，先講 Good afternoon 再辦正事；對方若夾皮欽語詞可保留，但回覆仍用標準英語。賴比瑞亞用詞偏美式。不要一開口就用正式過了頭的書面腔。
english_ok: yes — 英語是五國公務與多數店家用語；口音與皮欽語程度各地不同，鄉鎮櫃台有時較慢，但仍以英語溝通為主。
politeness: 對陌生人用 Sir / Madam 或 Please，先問 How are you? 再進入訂位；熟了才直呼名字。結尾 Thank you, have a good day。
name_tip: 報名加姓（如 Adaobi Okonkwo、Kwame Mensah）；約魯巴、伊博、阿肯等姓名先用已寫在訂位裡的拼法，必要時用日常拼字法逐個字母拼。
phone_tip: 奈及利亞國內手機連開頭 0 共 11 位（0803 123 4567 這類），市話區碼 2023 年起有調整（拉哥斯等在原區碼前加 20）。迦納連 0 共 10 位（024 123 4567）。獅子山、賴比瑞亞、甘比亞較短。國際冠碼 +234 / +233 / +232 / +231 / +220。朗讀分組。
time_tip: 口語多用 12 小時加 am/pm，書面可見 19:30。不要把 'I'll come now' 或皮欽語的時間承諾當成精確鐘點，請再確認整點。
number_tip: 金額先報奈拉、塞地或該國貨幣，不要混用。迦納常說 MoMo（MTN 等），奈及利亞更常說 transfer／POS／bank app，不要把 MoMo 說成五國同一個錢包。
avoid_calling: 避開 12:30–14:00 午餐與 18:30–20:30 晚餐高峰，以及週五在北部穆斯林地區的中午禮拜時段；週日上午許多辦公室不開。夜間 19:00 後少打給技師與機關。
closed_days: 獨立日各國不同；耶誕、新年、復活節常見。迦納假期以內政部公告為準（含開齋節等）。奈及利亞也常為復活節與伊德額外宣布假期。
booking_channels: WhatsApp 與電話仍是診所、沙龍與小館主流。拉哥斯、阿克拉可用 Dinesurf 查位；外送在奈及利亞有 Chowdeck 與 Glovo（覆蓋拉哥斯、阿布賈等），迦納則是 Bolt Food、Hubtel，Chowdeck 已進阿克拉。叫車用 Bolt（奈及利亞多城有），不要再用已退出奈及利亞的 Uber。迦納 MoMo 很普遍。
voice_menu: 銀行、MTN／Airtel／Glo、醫療保險與部分政府熱線有按鍵語音；小館與多數診所櫃台直接接聽。
callback_habits: 小店用 WhatsApp 回一句確認；Dinesurf 或診所網頁可能另發簡訊或應用內通知。不要只依賴電子郵件。

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 拉哥斯、阿克拉熱門館可用 Dinesurf 或 WhatsApp 留桌，週末晚上常要先訂；其他城市多半直接打電話。不要再問已退出迦納的 Glovo 能否訂位。
usually_asked: Date and sitting (lunch around 13:00 vs dinner around 19:00–20:00)
Party size and whether a high chair is needed
Indoor, AC room or outdoor garden
Name and a local mobile in the 0-plus format of that country
Whether they prefer a transfer, POS or cash

may_come_up.what: The table is already on Dinesurf and should keep that reference
A generator may affect kitchen hours during a light-out
Estate or compound security will ask for the guest's name at the gate

sensitive_asked.what: A transfer to an unlabelled personal account is demanded before the table is written down

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 許多私立診所可電話或 WhatsApp 掛號，奈及利亞也有 iBam 這類可查院所並預約門診的服務；公立醫院常要到場取號。
usually_asked: First visit or follow-up and the specialty
Patient name as on a national ID or hospital card
HMO, cash or a company account
Morning or afternoon slot

may_come_up.what: A public hospital may only issue numbers in person at opening time
The practice uses its own WhatsApp line rather than a web calendar

sensitive_asked.what: A third party is asked to read out a full medical file on the call

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮型、編髮與美甲幾乎都用 WhatsApp 約，電話打通後也常被請傳造型照片與要綁多久。
usually_asked: Braids, cut, nails or grooming and a realistic duration
Date and hour plus a backup slot
The WhatsApp number for the reminder

may_come_up.what: A stylist works from a compound and is known mainly by a first name or handle
A MoMo or transfer deposit is asked for a wedding booking

sensitive_asked.what: Identity photos are demanded in a private chat before any time is noted

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車、發電機與手機維修先 WhatsApp 傳照片再約到店或上門，電話只為確認師傅有沒有空。
usually_asked: What failed and the make (generator, handset, vehicle)
Bring-in versus a visit at the compound or office
When someone will be at the gate

may_come_up.what: A part may have to come from Accra or Lagos and the delay is loose

sensitive_asked.what: A diagnostic fee is demanded to a personal account before the item is seen

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 拉哥斯、阿布賈可用 Chowdeck 或 Glovo，阿克拉可用 Bolt Food、Hubtel 或 Chowdeck；小城則直接打電話或 WhatsApp 給餐廳。送餐地址要寫 estate 與 gate。
usually_asked: Dishes and portions, including spice or jollof style if it matters
Collection versus delivery to a named estate, close or compound
A number the rider can call at the gate, plus a landmark

may_come_up.what: Glovo left Ghana in 2024, so Accra orders should use Bolt Food, Hubtel or Chowdeck instead
The rider cannot enter an estate without a gate pass or a call to security

sensitive_asked.what: The rider asks to be paid into a personal wallet that is not the restaurant's

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 商店留貨多用 WhatsApp 對型號；較大零售才有網站。電話只確認還有沒有貨與何時可到店取。
usually_asked: Exact model, size or fabric and the quantity
Collect in store versus a dispatch to another area
Name to write on the set-aside goods

may_come_up.what: The item is in a warehouse in another district and will move the next working day

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to a private number is required before they confirm the item exists

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期回原 WhatsApp 或再打給同一間店，報名字與原時間；App 上的外送或訂位在同一 App 改。
usually_asked: Original day, hour and the name on the booking
The new slot or a cancellation
New headcount if it changes

may_come_up.what: A weekend table or bridal slot already took a transfer deposit

sensitive_asked.what: An extra transfer is demanded only to change the hour

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 問是否營業、收不收 transfer 或 POS，直接打或傳 WhatsApp 最準；網頁營業時間常常過時。
usually_asked: The exact question (hours, POS or MoMo, a dish, a spare part)
The day they plan to come
A number for a later WhatsApp reply

may_come_up.what: Payment brands differ: MoMo is the everyday word in Ghana, while Nigerian shops more often say transfer or POS

sensitive_asked.what: A stranger asks the owner to read a banking PIN or SMS token aloud

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 都市旅館可用 Booking.com 或官網，賓館與服務公寓多用 WhatsApp 問空房；入住常要出示身份證件。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates and the number of guests
Room type and whether breakfast is included
Name as on the ID or passport and a WhatsApp number

may_come_up.what: A generator or water schedule may be mentioned for a smaller guesthouse

sensitive_asked.what: A passport scan plus a transfer to a personal account is demanded before confirmation

activity.before_dialing_zh: 旅行團、海灘與週末活動多經主辦 WhatsApp 或網站報名，常有最低人數；出發前會再確認集合點。
usually_asked: Which outing and the date, with a weather backup
Adults and children and the meeting point
A mobile that will work on the road

may_come_up.what: The trip leaves only with a minimum group

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to an unnamed personal wallet is required with no receipt

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電、發電機與清潔靠 WhatsApp 約上門，地址要寫 estate、close 或 compound，並說明 gate 怎麼放行。
usually_asked: The job and a visit window
Estate, close or compound and how to pass the gate
A number that will answer security or the occupant

may_come_up.what: The technician quotes only after a WhatsApp photo or a short inspection

sensitive_asked.what: A gate code and a remote prepayment are demanded before any visit

pet.before_dialing_zh: 都市獸醫可電話或 WhatsApp 預約，其他地方常是上午到場；要說明動物種類與疫苗。
usually_asked: Species, size and the reason for the visit
First visit or a booster
Owner name and a reachable mobile

may_come_up.what: Boarding may need a vaccination card

sensitive_asked.what: A personal transfer is demanded to reserve a kennel with no clinic name

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 國內物流與從港口、機場取件常要打電話或用業者 WhatsApp，單號加上收件城市與 estate 名稱較有用。
usually_asked: Waybill and the destination city
Name on the parcel and a local contact
Depot collection versus delivery to a named estate

may_come_up.what: A cash-on-delivery balance may be due in naira or cedis

sensitive_asked.what: A wallet top-up is requested to 'release' an unidentified parcel

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行、MTN／Airtel 與 MoMo 客服多半先入語音選單；備妥帳號或錢包號碼，不要在電話裡報 PIN 或 SMS 代碼。
usually_asked: Which bank or operator and the account, SIM or wallet label
The issue in one sentence
The name on the contract and a callback number

may_come_up.what: They may send the customer to a service centre with a valid ID

sensitive_asked.what: Anyone asks for a PIN, USSD code or one-time SMS on the call

transport.before_dialing_zh: 奈及利亞與迦納都市用 Bolt（或 inDrive）叫車即可，不必先打電話；Uber 已退出奈及利亞。小城與機場接送仍可用 WhatsApp 約熟司機。
usually_asked: Pickup and drop-off (estate, hotel, airport) and the time
Passengers and bags
A number the driver can call at the gate

may_come_up.what: Bolt already covers the city, so a phone dispatch is unnecessary
Airport traffic may need an earlier set-off than the map suggests

sensitive_asked.what: A driver asks for the full fare to a personal account before sharing a plate

property.before_dialing_zh: 看房經仲介或房東 WhatsApp 約，常被要求先出示證件；地址用 estate、close 與地標。
usually_asked: Viewing time and rent or sale
Name and a number at the gate
Budget in naira or cedis if asked

may_come_up.what: The agent wants to see an ID before opening a furnished flat
Service charge or generator levy may be separate from the advertised rent

sensitive_asked.what: A reservation fee to a personal account is demanded before any accompanied visit

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 公家單位與學校窗口常要本人取號，電話多只能問文件與開放時間；語氣保持正式。
usually_asked: Which office or school and the purpose
The person's name as on a national ID or passport
Whether a ticket is issued only in person and from which hour

may_come_up.what: Many counters close around midday or on a freshly announced public holiday

sensitive_asked.what: A caller claiming to be from an office asks for a personal transfer to speed up a file

appointment_words: take the car to the mechanic
order_words: put one aside in the shop
